title: Insert into a Sorted Circular Linked List
problemStatement: Given a node from a sorted circular linked list and an integer insertVal, insert a new node with the given value into the list while maintaining the sorted order. Return any node from the circular linked list after insertion.
input: Circular sorted linked list Integer insertVal
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 5 × 10^4] -10^6 <= insertVal <= 10^6
